recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It fixes a localized FHIR-44837 source-placement error while preserving subsequent Applied decisions for the same element family.
issue_request: FHIR-44837 was an Applied/Persuasive BR&R R6 change request to add ResearchSubject.subjectMilestone 0..* with milestone, date, and reason children. The requested reason child included an example for a Randomized milestone reason.
initial_application: Commit 2613dc6b190788d1f1389d8e4a1ec46b60c86445 added the subjectMilestone backbone. Follow-up commit ced800ad6ca3bbd704fcbabb0556b03871a28452 was titled as adding the ResearchSubject.subjectMilestone.reason comment, but the actual hunk placed the milestone example on ResearchSubject.subjectState.reason.
additional_context: Later Applied/Persuasive decisions intentionally changed parts of the original request: FHIR-49255 changed the milestone binding strength from extensible to example, FHIR-50388 changed subjectMilestone.milestone to 1..1 and subjectMilestone.reason to 0..* with a StateChangeReason example binding, and FHIR-56598 changed the milestone ValueSet URL to the THO plural URL. FHIR-56598 already has a combined-branch audit commit.
reconciliation: Edited the active ResearchSubject StructureDefinition source to remove the misplaced example comment from ResearchSubject.subjectState.reason and add it to ResearchSubject.subjectMilestone.reason. Cardinalities and bindings from later BR&R decisions were preserved.
source_changes: source/researchsubject/structuredefinition-ResearchSubject.xml: moved the Randomized milestone reason example comment from ResearchSubject.subjectState.reason to ResearchSubject.subjectMilestone.reason.
